environment.postgres: 16.14 (embedded, loopback; timezone UTC, jit off, fsync off, shared_buffers 256MB)
environment.production: Render web service plan 1c-2g (1 vCPU, 2 GB), Singapore, managed PostgreSQL 17 — NOT measured; production statement latency adds network round trips
environment.scope: dedicated disposable database season_final_qualification_benchmark; synthetic fills inserted under the real CHECKs and triggers; warm cache; no Provider/Redis/HTTP; nothing else running during the 1,000/10,000 runs
environment.distribution: skewed: per participant 1% 3,000 fills, 9% 500, 30% 100, 60% 10 (mean 111); 30% Futures executions with pinned FX, 20% USD Spot with pinned FX, 50% KRW Spot. worst-batch: participants 1-50 (one read batch) 3,000 fills each, others 10
environment.metrics: ms = wall time; statements/rows = driver level; heapGrowthMb = peak heap above the post-GC start; peakRssMb includes the ~295 MB process baseline; maxSeasonLockMs = longest season row FOR UPDATE to COMMIT/ROLLBACK
environment.command: SEASON_FINAL_QUALIFICATION_BENCHMARK=1 NODE_ENV=test NODE_OPTIONS='--expose-gc' DATABASE_URL=<loopback>/season_final_qualification_benchmark SEASON_QUALIFICATION_BENCHMARK_SIZES=1000,10000 SEASON_QUALIFICATION_BENCHMARK_SETTLE_UP_TO=10000 [SEASON_QUALIFICATION_BENCHMARK_PARTS=reads,settlement,final] [SEASON_QUALIFICATION_BENCHMARK_PROFILE=worst-batch] pnpm exec tsx scripts/season-final-qualification-benchmark.ts
